**"___ card"**: credit card, charge card, wild card... 

**"Taking a ___"**: chance, shot, turn, miss? No...

**"Out of ___"**: turn (out of turn), time (out of time), chance, shot?

Let me think about "second ___": second chance, second shot, second turn, second wind... 

**"___s" meaning failures**: flop, bust, dud, miss ✓ (all mean a failure/disappointment)

**Credit/payment related**: credit, charge, plastic, card - these all relate to payment methods (credit card, charge card, plastic, card)

That leaves: chance, shot, turn, time, miss, kindle, prime, river, rainforest

Amazon group: kindle, prime, river, rainforest ✓

Payment: credit, charge, plastic, card ✓ (all types of payment/card)

Remaining: chance, shot, turn, time

These could all follow "over": overtime, overturn, overcharge... hmm.
Or precede something: chance, shot, turn, time...
- "Fat ___": fat chance, fat shot? No.
- "___ table": timetable, turntable... 
- "Long ___": long shot, long chance, long turn, long time? "Longtime," "long shot," "long chance" (not common), "long turn"?
- "Last ___": last chance, last shot, last turn, last time? Yes! These all work with "last"!

So the groups are:

2. **Failures/flops**: flop, bust, dud, miss

4. **Last ___**: chance, shot, turn, time
